en.headline: Three taxi drivers disqualified under demerit points system
en.dek: The transport chief disclosed for the first time that three drivers have been banned for three months after accumulating 15 points or more since the scheme began in 2024.
body: Three Hong Kong taxi drivers have been disqualified from driving taxis for three months after accumulating 15 demerit points or more under the Taxi-Driver-Offence Points system, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said.

In a reply to a Legislative Council question, Chan disclosed the figures for the first time. Since the system took effect in September 2024, 229 drivers had incurred points as of 2 October, including 125 cases of refusing a hire. The system covers 11 offences; drivers face a three-month ban on first reaching 15 points within two years, and six months for subsequent cases.

Between the start of the scheme and August this year the Transport Department received nearly 6,000 driver-related complaints, of which 605 involved refusal of hire. Chan said the department investigates complaints, refers cases to enforcement agencies where appropriate, and writes to owners or drivers to remind them of their obligations. From the end of this year taxis must be equipped with journey-recording systems.

zh.headline: 的士違例記分制下3名司機被取消駕駛資格3個月
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶首次披露，自2024年9月制度生效以來，已有3名司機因累積15分或以上被判停牌3個月。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶在立法會回覆質詢時表示，自的士司機違例記分制度於2024年9月22日生效以來，截至本月2日共有229名司機被記分，其中3名因累積15分或以上已被取消駕駛的士資格3個月。
拒載個案佔125宗。制度涵蓋11項影響服務質素的違例事項，司機在任何兩年內累積15分或以上可被取消資格，首次3個月，其後6個月。
由制度實施至今年8月，運輸署接獲約5944宗與的士司機有關的投訴，其中605宗涉及拒載。署方會調查投訴，視乎性質轉交執法部門，並致函車主或司機提醒遵守法例。年底起的士須安裝行程記錄系統。
